providers.r1: Sanity stays authoritative until every core row below is native and the full matrix passes; it may not be retired in the milestone that introduces its replacement.
The Strapi chassis is a migration scaffold, not a required service; no external Strapi project may become a prerequisite.
Local BYO-model planning has dated evidence (P-017, 2026-10-18); hosted adapters remain optional and keyed only when selected.
P-108 is covered with live Google evidence; do not retire OIDC until local identity has its own live evidence and parity row (R1).
The only live send on record is Resend (P-095); native SMTP has no live mailbox submission, so Resend may not be retired yet.
Required only when payments are used; never a prerequisite for unrelated local features.
A carrier, SIP/PBX or modem is required by the network itself; not removable by software.
Public web research needs a network or source; the paid search API stays optional.

capabilities.gaps: Ten collection schemas exist, but no Strapi host is present and the plugin is not runtime-registered; relations do not enforce same-tenant composite keys.
capabilities.r1: Keep Sanity authoritative until schema, relation and admin parity pass.

capabilities.feature: Tenant-scoped queries, filters, sorting and pagination
capabilities.gaps: Query contracts are TODOs; no native repository executes a tenant-scoped query.
capabilities.r1: Sanity queries remain the only implemented path.

capabilities.feature: Decision records, audit history and snapshots
capabilities.gaps: Decision reads and writes go through Sanity; there is no native decision store.
capabilities.r1: Keep Sanity until decisions, approvals and audit history have native durable storage.

capabilities.gaps: Catalog reads are Sanity queries; no native catalog repository.
capabilities.r1: Keep Sanity for catalog reads.

capabilities.gaps: Publication history is stored in Sanity; no native revision store.
capabilities.r1: Keep Sanity until publication history and digest checks are native.

capabilities.gaps: Chat and inbox reads and writes are Sanity-backed.
capabilities.r1: Keep Sanity until chat and inbox have native storage and retention rules.

capabilities.gaps: Studio is the Sanity application; there is no native admin or editor.
capabilities.r1: Sanity Studio stays the admin surface until a native one passes parity.

capabilities.gaps: Seeding is Sanity document tooling; there are no native fixtures or a clean-install seed.
capabilities.r1: Keep Sanity seeding until native fixtures exist.

capabilities.gaps: Context assembly is a placeholder; grounded query uses Sanity Context MCP.
capabilities.r1: Keep the Context MCP path until native retrieval has parity and refusal tests.

capabilities.gaps: The rehearsal harness compares exported JSONL by id and SHA-256 digest, verifies snapshot integrity and restores a snapshot. It has not run against a real Sanity export, does not prove tenant refusals or a deployed restart/restore, and has no owner sign-off.
capabilities.r1: No cutover may begin before a rehearsal runs on real exports with a tested rollback and owner sign-off.

capabilities.gaps: 37 of 51 operations validate against a mocked empty store with 0 unimportable route modules; the remaining 14 are not successful (8 answer 500, 5 answer 503, 1 answers 401) and need seeded data, a model provider, product-memory root, entity store, or a browser session. The older "42 of 46" credential-baseline figure is the pre-operator snapshot at 3f7261c, when the tree had 45 route files and 46 operations.
capabilities.r1: The contract stays partial until the unvalidated operations run against a real body.

capabilities.gaps: Every schema carries tenantId, but the field alone is not a boundary; no native repository enforces same-tenant relations or derives tenant identity from a principal.
capabilities.r1: Sanity plus kernel authorization remains the isolation path.

capabilities.gaps: No native backup, restore, lifecycle or disaster-recovery procedure.
capabilities.r1: Sanity export stays the backup path.

capabilities.feature: Core features work with Sanity unset
capabilities.gaps: A Sanity token or the test mock is required for every data-backed route; a clean install with Sanity unset cannot serve them.
capabilities.r1: This row is the removal gate itself; it may not be marked native before every other core row is native.

capabilities.feature: Model access without a hosted key
capabilities.r1: Dated P-017 evidence (2026-10-18): local llama3.2:3b staged planning with 100% valid schema and zero fabricated IDs. Hosted adapters stay optional.

capabilities.gaps: No hardware detection, pinned local runtime, checksum-verified model download, interrupted-download recovery or model health surface.
capabilities.r1: Hosted keys stay permitted until local provisioning is implemented and evidenced.

capabilities.gaps: Adapters exist and are tested, but require a provider key only when selected; a missing key must never silently switch providers.
capabilities.r1: Optional by design; no retirement needed.

capabilities.gaps: Sign-in works through Google (P-108 covered with live evidence), but it is not product-owned; there is no local credential.

capabilities.gaps: No enrollment, local signing/encryption keys, rotation, recovery or revocation.

capabilities.gaps: Session storage is tied to the OIDC flow; no native session store or local revocation path.
capabilities.r1: Keep the OIDC session path until a native store proves revocation and restart survival.

capabilities.gaps: Implicit TLS 465 and AUTH PLAIN only; no STARTTLS, OAuth, attachments, IMAP or inbound. A successful submission means server acceptance, not inbox delivery.

capabilities.gaps: Port 587 STARTTLS is refused; there is no plaintext downgrade.
capabilities.r1: Keep Resend where STARTTLS is required.

capabilities.gaps: No IMAP/POP3 polling, MIME parsing, thread handling or inbound identity.
capabilities.r1: Inbound email remains unsupported natively; Resend is outbound only.

capabilities.gaps: The only live send on record is Resend (P-095); native SMTP has no live mailbox submission evidence.
capabilities.r1: C6/R1: do not retire Resend on scripted-stream tests alone.
